# GenMatrix NFT Generator

GenMatrix is a free browser-based NFT generator for artists, designer toy creators, 3D collectible teams, blockchain projects, and Web3 communities.

Primary topics:
- Free NFT generator
- NFT art generator
- Designer toy and art toy collection workflow
- 3D NFT and digital collectible generation
- Blockchain marketplace metadata
- Rarity rules, layer art, trait compatibility, DNA export
- Art, designer toys, 3D NFT, blockchain, free Web3 tools

The app runs locally in the browser. Imported artwork stays on the user's device unless the user exports or uploads files elsewhere.

Canonical URL:
https://genmatrix.xyz/
